summary: iter438 retest of AssignmentCreateDrawer Pass C draft restore. PRIOR P0 (ReferenceError 'pendingDraft is not defined') IS FIXED — dispatch board loads cleanly with zero red overlay. Autosave to localStorage works. HOWEVER a NEW P0 emerged: the load-on-open hook that the prior report explicitly called for was NOT added. _readDraft is defined but never called anywhere in the file (grep: 0 call sites), so pendingDraft stays null forever and the DraftRestorePrompt never renders. Net result: the drawer no longer crashes, but the entire restore round-trip is non-functional — a saved draft can never be surfaced to the user.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing load-on-open useEffect. _readDraft helper is defined at line 316 but never invoked anywhere in the module (grep confirms zero call sites). pendingDraft is initialized to null at line 313 and is only ever set back to null by onRestoreDraft (line 443) and onDiscardDraft (line 449). Consequence: <DraftRestorePrompt pendingDraft={pendingDraft} ...> at line 662 always receives null, and DraftRestorePrompt returns null when pendingDraft is null (resiliency/DraftRestorePrompt.jsx line 28). The restore prompt can therefore never appear, even after autosave has demonstrably written a valid draft to localStorage. Verified live: opened drawer, typed 'Hello draft test 123' into ac-note, waited 1.5s, confirmed localStorage['masci.draft.dispatch-assignment-new'] contains {note:'Hello draft test 123', savedAt:<ms>} — then closed and reopened, restore prompt did NOT appear.

critical_code_review_comments: iter438 fix delivered 4 of the 5 required pieces (DRAFT_KEY const, DRAFT_TTL_MS const, useState for pendingDraft, useRef for draftTimerRef, three useCallback helpers) but dropped the fifth: the useEffect that calls setPendingDraft(_readDraft()) when open transitions to true. The handoff brief on this iteration even listed it as one of the 6 unchanged consumers ('reset-on-open setPendingDraft call'), but no such call exists in the file. This is the second incomplete merge of the same logical block in two iterations — recommend the main agent diff against the PRD's reference snippet before claiming completion next time.

Helper functions _readDraft/_writeDraft/_clearDraft are correctly memoized with useCallback and have stable empty dep arrays — once the missing useEffect is added it will work without lint complaints.
DRAFT_KEY and DRAFT_TTL_MS are defined inside the component body. They are constants — could hoist to module scope to avoid re-creating on every render. Cosmetic only.
The autosave useEffect at lines 403–423 correctly skips writing for an empty fresh form (isEmptyFresh check) which prevents a phantom draft from being created the first time the drawer opens. Nice.
Submit success path correctly calls _clearDraft() at line 599 before onClose — draft is destroyed only after the POST returns 2xx. Correct doctrine.

rca_of_the_issue: ROOT CAUSE: AssignmentCreateDrawer.jsx defines _readDraft as a useCallback at line 316–328 but never calls it. The component initializes pendingDraft to null via useState (line 313) and never transitions it to a non-null value except inside onRestoreDraft/onDiscardDraft (both of which set it back to null). DraftRestorePrompt (resiliency/DraftRestorePrompt.jsx line 28) renders null when pendingDraft is null, so the prompt is structurally unreachable from any user flow. REPRODUCTION: multi-login → set masci.admin.token + masci.dispatch.token → goto /dispatch-portal/board → click 'board-create-assignment' → type into 'ac-note' → wait 1s (autosave fires, localStorage['masci.draft.dispatch-assignment-new'] populated) → click 'assignment-create-close' → click 'board-create-assignment' again → observe: drawer remounts but no 'assignment-create-draft-restore-prompt' anywhere in DOM. MITIGATION: insert a useEffect that runs setPendingDraft(_readDraft()) when open becomes true, immediately after the reset-on-open effect (~line 361). See action_items for the exact 5-line patch.
